description.it: Installa e configura nvim-dap con le mappature F5-F12 standard.
description.en: Install and configure nvim-dap with standard F5-F12 mappings.

steps: Configura keymaps F5, F10, F11, F12
hints: F5 = continue, F10 = step_over, F11 = step_into, F12 = step_out
exercises.solution:
return {
  'mfussenegger/nvim-dap',
  config = function()
    local dap = require('dap')
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<F5>', dap.continue)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<F10>', dap.step_over)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<F11>', dap.step_into)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<F12>', dap.step_out)
    vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>db', dap.toggle_breakpoint)
  end,
}

description.it: Aggiungi nvim-dap-ui e configurane l'apertura automatica all'avvio del debug.
description.en: Add nvim-dap-ui and configure auto-open when debugging starts.

steps: Testa avviando una sessione di debug
exercises.solution:
dapui.setup()

dap.listeners.after.event_initialized['dapui_config'] = function()
  dapui.open()
end
dap.listeners.before.event_terminated['dapui_config'] = function()
  dapui.close()
end
dap.listeners.before.event_exited['dapui_config'] = function()
  dapui.close()
end

description.it: Configura nvim-dap-python per debuggare script Python.
description.en: Configure nvim-dap-python to debug Python scripts.

steps: Imposta il path a debugpy da Mason
Crea configurazione launch per file corrente
Aggiungi keymap per debug test method
Testa su un file Python con errori
exercises.solution:
local path = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/mason/packages/debugpy/venv/bin/python'
require('dap-python').setup(path)

vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>dpr', function()
  require('dap-python').test_method()
end)

description.it: Imposta keymap per gestire watch expressions.
description.en: Set up keymaps to manage watch expressions.

hints: Accedi agli elementi UI via dapui.elements
exercises.solution:
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>dw', function()
  local expr = vim.fn.input('Watch: ')
  require('dapui').elements.watches.add(expr)
end)

vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>drw', function()
  require('dapui').elements.watches.remove()
end)

description.it: Integra Telescope per navigare breakpoint e frame.
description.en: Integrate Telescope to navigate breakpoints and frames.

steps: Testa la navigazione durante una sessione
exercises.solution:
require('telescope').load_extension('dap')

vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>dfb', function()
  require('telescope').extensions.dap.list_breakpoints()
end)

vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>dff', function()
  require('telescope').extensions.dap.frames()
end)
